info.title: Phone Number Validation API
info.description:
Provides methods for validating phone numbers against mobile network data.
Supports single-number validation as well as bulk validation jobs, with
endpoints to create a job, check its processing status, and retrieve the
full results once complete.

region.description: The Dotdigital region id your account belongs to

parameters.name: phoneNumber
parameters.description: Number of phone to validate. This can be in local format if the 'country' parameter is also supplied.

parameters.name: countryCode
parameters.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or aplha-3 country code in CAPITALS. You must provide this if the number is in local format.

get.description: Gets a list of bulk phone number validation jobs.

post.description: Queues a bulk phone number validation request with a CSV file containing the numbers to be validated.

requestBody.description: A multipart/form-data request containing the CSV file and its processing options.

schema.description: The unique job identifier for the bulk phone number validation job.

get.description: Gets the details and status of a bulk phone number validation job.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The unqiue job identifier for the async bulk phone number validation

get.description:
Gets the results file of a successful bulk phone number validation job.

*Note: Failed or incomplete jobs will return no data!*

Output CSV file includes:
* Phone Number
* Original Phone Number
* Status
* MCCMNC
* Network Name
* Network Prefix
* Country IDD
* Is Ported
* Ported From Network Name
* Roaming Network Name
* Roaming Network Prefix
* Roaming Country IsoCode
* Roaming Country IDD

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: The unqiue job identifier for the async bulk phone number validation

status.description: The current mobile network status for the number being checked.

countryIdd.description: The dialling code for the country.

jobId.description: The unique identifier for the job.

userId.description: The identifier of the user who initiated the job.

filename.description: The original name of the uploaded file.

countryIsoCode.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code used for processing.

phoneNumberCount.description: The total count of phone numbers found in the file.

invalidCount.description: The count of invalid records found.

liveInfoCount.description: The count of records for which live information was retrieved.

chargeableLiveInfoCount.description: The subset of live info records that are chargeable.

status.description: The current processing status of the job.

percentComplete.description: The completion percentage of the job.

created.description: The UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the job was created.

updated.description: The UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when the job was last updated.

minRetention.description: The UTC ISO 8601 timestamp defining the minimum retention date for the job data.

filePath.description: A secure URL to the processed output file, if applicable.

numberColumnName.description: The name of the column in the source CSV that contains the phone numbers.

csvDelimiter.description: The delimiter character used in the source CSV file.

hasHeader.description: Indicates whether the source CSV file has a header row.

statusFlag.description: An additional flag providing context about the job's status.

apiSpaceId.description: The unique identifier for the API space this job belongs to.

JobDetails.description: Represents the status and details of an asynchronous phone number validation job.

csv.description: The CSV file with mobile numbers to be validated.

separator.description: The separator used between fields in the CSV.

country.description: The country for the bulk validation in ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format.

isHeader.description: `true` if the CSV file has a header row.

isInternational.description: `true` if all numbers in the file are in international format.

phoneField.description: The name of the field that contains the mobile number to be validated.

networkName.description: The name of the network being used currently.

countryCode.description: The country code of the country the phone is roaming within in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

countryIdd.description: The dialling code of the country the phone is roaming within.

countryName.description: The name of the country the phone is roaming within.

SingleValidation_networkDetails_roaming.description: The roaming details, if the phone is currently roaming

isPorted.description: Flag indicating that the number has been ported from one network to another.

portedFromNetworkName.description: The network the phone was ported from.

networkName.description: The mobile network name the number is registered to.

mccmnc.description: The mobile country code and mobile network code.

SingleValidation_networkDetails.description: The mobile network details for the number.
